axes.PICTURE: two DESCRIPTIONS of one object (equivalence often provable)
axes.INSIDE/OUT: participant view vs observer view (self-reference lives here)
axes.SCALE: truth changes with degrees of freedom / dimension (renormalization)
axes.RESOLUTION: how finely you look: discrete vs continuous

entries.name: Our Gamma-equation (wave / particle)
entries.multiplicity: 2 here, but Gamma is a whole LINE of values — the binary is a slice
entries.pic_A: PARTICLE/fusion: Gamma in N0, a multiplicity (discrete count)
entries.pic_B: WAVE/dynamics: Gamma in R, a continuous coordinate
entries.primary: NEITHER (our explicit claim). v9 corpus leaned particle as primary; v10 demotes that to a chart-choice.
entries.equiv: Same monic quadratic x^2-x-Gamma; based ring Z[t]/(t^2-t-a) is the integer points of the continuous family.
entries.seam_tradeoff: spread sqrt(1/4+Gamma) is free; integer-count and continuous-flow can't be held in one breath
entries.gloss: Counting whole things vs sliding a dial — same equation underneath.
entries.analogy: Stairs (you can only stand on a step) vs a ramp (any height). Same climb.

entries.name: Wave / Particle (quantum)
entries.multiplicity: 2 descriptions, but position alone is already 3 (x,y,z) — picture-count and dimension-count are different things
entries.primary: NEITHER (Bohr complementarity). Yet textbooks pick one per problem — the smuggle is pedagogical, not physical.
entries.equiv: One state vector, two bases (position/momentum), related by Fourier; Dirac/von Neumann exact.
entries.seam_invariant: the state vector and its norm = 1
entries.seam_tradeoff: Heisenberg dx*dp >= hbar/2 — no simultaneous sharpness
entries.gloss: A thing that is here-and-countable OR spread-out-and-rhythmic, never crisply both.
entries.analogy: A photo (frozen position) vs a song (a frequency). You can't freeze a song.

entries.name: Time / Frequency (Fourier)
entries.multiplicity: 2, but generalizes: any orthonormal basis is another 'picture' (wavelets, etc.) — infinitely many charts
entries.primary: NEITHER — fully symmetric (Fourier is its own near-inverse).
entries.equiv: Fourier = unitary isomorphism L2->L2, fully invertible.
entries.seam_tradeoff: Gabor limit: can't be sharp in both time and frequency. SAME THEOREM as Heisenberg.
entries.gloss: When something happens vs what rhythms it's made of.
entries.analogy: A drum HIT (sharp in time) vs a sustained TONE (sharp in pitch). Pure hit has no pitch; pure tone has no moment.

entries.name: Heisenberg / Schrodinger (QM formulations)
entries.multiplicity: 2 named, plus the 'interaction picture' = a 3rd. So really many; 2 is convention.
entries.primary: NEITHER — provably same predictions. Historical primacy fight (Heisenberg vs Schrodinger 1926) was ego, not physics.
entries.equiv: Equivalent (von Neumann); related by a time-dependent unitary — a frame change.
entries.seam_tradeoff: time-dependence must live somewhere (states OR operators), not nowhere, not fully both
entries.gloss: Does the movie move, or does the camera move? Same movie.
entries.analogy: Watching scenery from a moving train: say the train moves, or say the world slides past. Both correct.

entries.name: Frequentist / Bayesian (probability)  [CONTROL]
entries.multiplicity: genuinely 2 stances, and they do NOT merge — a real fork, not a chart-choice
entries.primary: Each camp claims primacy for itself — and neither can be dislodged, BECAUSE there is no proven equivalence to appeal to.
entries.equiv: NOT a clean iso. Shared Kolmogorov axioms; agree numerically in large samples (Bernstein-von Mises) but disagree on what probability IS. HONEST GAP.
entries.seam_invariant: only the shared axioms (algebra), NOT a conserved quantity
entries.seam_tradeoff: can't have both 'pure objective frequency' AND 'applies to one-off events' — a forced choice, not a theorem
entries.gloss: Probability as 'how often it happens if you repeat' vs 'how sure I am right now'.
entries.analogy: A coin's 50% as 'half of a million flips' vs 'my confidence on THIS flip'. The single flip has no frequency.
entries.note: CONTROL CASE + a clue: this duality lives on the INSIDE/OUTSIDE axis, not PICTURE. The shape is weaker here. Open question: is it weak because equiv is unproven, OR because inside/outside dualities are structurally different from picture dualities? >>> NEW HYPOTHESIS from Kelly's axis idea.

entries.name: Energy / Entropy (Legendre / thermo)
entries.multiplicity: a whole FAMILY of potentials (U,F,G,H...) — pick which variables are control. Many charts.
entries.primary: NEITHER — you choose by which variable you can hold fixed in the lab.
entries.seam_tradeoff: per conjugate pair you fix ONE and read the other; can't fix both
entries.gloss: Describe a gas by its energy-and-disorder, or by its temperature-and-energy. Same gas.
entries.analogy: Describing a hill by height-at-each-point vs by slope-at-each-point. Same hill, different handle.

entries.name: Geometry / Algebra (Stone / Gelfand)
entries.multiplicity: 2 categories, but the equivalence is the whole POINT — maximal merger.
entries.primary: NEITHER — contravariant EQUIVALENCE makes them literally interchangeable.
entries.equiv: Gelfand & Stone: contravariant equivalences of categories.
entries.gloss: A shape, or the catalogue of all measurements you can make on it. Same information.
entries.analogy: A city, vs the complete phone book + map + every fact about it. Reconstruct either from the other.

entries.name: Micro / Macro (statistical mechanics)  [SCALE]
entries.multiplicity: not really 2 — a CONTINUUM of scales; 'micro vs macro' is two ends of a dial (renormalization flow)
entries.pic_A: MICRO: 10^23 particles, positions+momenta (reversible, no arrow of time)
entries.pic_B: MACRO: temperature, pressure, entropy (irreversible, has an arrow)
entries.primary: Reductionists smuggle MICRO as primary. But temperature is MEANINGLESS for 3 particles — the macro concepts don't even EXIST at micro scale.
entries.equiv: NOT an equivalence — it is a PROJECTION (many micro-states -> one macro-state). Information is LOST going up. This is a different relation than the picture-dualities.
entries.seam_invariant: conserved totals (energy, particle number) survive both scales
entries.seam_tradeoff: you cannot have both full microscopic detail AND a sharp macroscopic concept like temperature — temperature only emerges by THROWING AWAY detail
entries.gloss: Tracking every molecule vs reading one thermometer. The thermometer fact isn't 'in' any single molecule.
entries.analogy: A crowd's MOOD vs each person's exact thoughts. 'The crowd is angry' is real and is in NO single person.
entries.note: Directly answers Kelly's 'truth changes with degrees of freedom'. Here truth is SCALE-RELATIVE: temperature is true at high DOF, undefined at low DOF. The seam-shape PARTLY holds (invariant + tradeoff) but the relation is projection, not equivalence. CRACK to examine, not paper over.

entries.name: Syntax / Semantics (logic, language)
entries.multiplicity: 2 classically, but model theory gives MANY models (semantics) for one syntax — multiplicity is real
entries.pic_A: SYNTAX: symbols + rules, pure form, provability (|-)
entries.pic_B: SEMANTICS: meaning, truth in a model (|=)
entries.primary: Formalists smuggle SYNTAX primary; Platonists smuggle SEMANTICS primary.
entries.equiv: Goedel COMPLETENESS: for first-order logic, provable iff true-in-all-models (|- = |=). A REAL equivalence. BUT Goedel INCOMPLETENESS: for arithmetic, there are true statements not provable — the seam DOES NOT fully close. The gap is a THEOREM.
entries.seam_invariant: logical consequence on the closable part (completeness region)
entries.seam_tradeoff: for rich-enough systems, truth EXCEEDS proof — you cannot have both 'every truth is provable' AND 'the system is consistent + expressive'
entries.gloss: The rules of the game vs what the game is about. Mostly they match — but in rich systems, some truths can never be proven from inside.
entries.analogy: A rulebook vs the actual play. For checkers the rulebook captures everything; for life it never quite does.
entries.note: HUGE for Kelly's frame: Goedel is the FIRST-CLASS proof that the gap between truth and proof is STRUCTURAL and UN-CLOSABLE for any rich system. This is the 'unnameable cannot be proven, by construction' — but as a hard theorem about formal systems, NOT a mystical claim. The inside/outside axis is exactly why: a system can't fully see itself from inside. [PROVEN that the gap exists.]

entries.name: Special / General Relativity (flat / curved)  [SCALE]
entries.multiplicity: not 2 — a LIMIT: SR is GR at zero curvature / locally. One theory, scale-dependent face.
entries.pic_A: SPECIAL: flat spacetime, global inertial frames
entries.pic_B: GENERAL: curved spacetime, only LOCAL inertial frames
entries.primary: SR is not 'wrong' and GR 'right' — SR is the local/tangent picture, true in the small. Primacy is a domain-of-validity question, not truth-vs-false.
entries.equiv: SR = GR restricted to a tangent space / vanishing curvature. A LIMIT relation, not an equivalence. Every curved space looks flat up close (the equivalence principle IS this statement).
entries.seam_invariant: the speed of light c; local Lorentz invariance (true in BOTH)
entries.seam_tradeoff: you cannot have both a GLOBAL inertial frame AND real gravity/curvature — gravity is exactly the failure of global flatness
entries.gloss: Physics on a flat table vs physics on a curved Earth. Up close the Earth looks flat and the table-rules work; zoomed out they don't.
entries.analogy: A city map (flat, fine for your block) vs a globe (true overall). Your block isn't 'wrong', it's just the local chart.
entries.note: Pure ATLAS structure in the geometric sense: GR literally needs an atlas of local flat charts. Kelly's word, again literal. The 'no single chart covers the manifold' fact IS general relativity.

entries.name: Discrete / Continuous (calculus: sum / integral)  [RESOLUTION]
entries.multiplicity: a LIMIT of finer and finer partitions — infinitely many intermediate charts
entries.pic_A: DISCRETE: a finite sum of rectangles (Riemann), countable pieces
entries.pic_B: CONTINUOUS: the integral, the limit as pieces -> 0 width
entries.primary: NEITHER is wrong: the discrete sum APPROACHES the integral. Numerical analysts use discrete; analysts use continuous. Same area.
entries.equiv: The integral is DEFINED as the limit of the discrete sums (Riemann/Lebesgue). Not a bijection, not a projection — a LIMIT: refine the partition, the sum CONVERGES to the integral. Information is ADDED monotonically as you refine; nothing is lost, nothing is blocked.
entries.seam_invariant: the total (the area / the measure) — the limit value all refinements agree on
entries.seam_tradeoff: finite computability vs exactness: a finite sum is computable but approximate; the exact value needs an infinite limit you can't finish by hand
entries.gloss: Adding up tiny blocks vs the smooth total they're heading toward.
entries.analogy: Counting staircase steps vs the ramp they approximate — add more, shorter steps and the staircase BECOMES the ramp in the limit.
entries.note: THE FOURTH-RELATION TEST CASE. Relation = REFINEMENT/LIMIT: info added monotonically, two ends joined by a convergence process. Distinct from equivalence (bijective), projection (lossy), un-closable (blocked).

entries.name: Observer / Observed (quantum measurement)  [INSIDE/OUT]
entries.multiplicity: 2 named (system, apparatus) but the 'cut' between them is MOVABLE — infinitely many places to draw it (von Neumann chain)
entries.pic_A: OBSERVED: the quantum system, unitary, superposed (described from OUTSIDE)
entries.pic_B: OBSERVER: the measuring apparatus + you, which sees a definite outcome (INSIDE)
entries.primary: The 'measurement problem': no agreed primary. Where the quantum/classical CUT goes is not fixed by the theory — it is CHOSEN. That movability is the problem.
entries.equiv: NOT resolved. Unitary QM (outside view) predicts superposition; experience (inside view) is definite. The transition ('collapse') is not derived from within unitary QM — it is added by hand or pushed off (many-worlds, decoherence soften but don't fully close it). A genuine OPEN seam, not just unproven.
entries.seam_invariant: the Born-rule probabilities (both views must reproduce them) and unitarity below the cut
entries.seam_tradeoff: you cannot have BOTH a fully unitary universe (no collapse, everything superposed) AND your single definite experienced outcome — not within one non-mystical account everyone accepts
entries.gloss: The world as all-possibilities-at-once vs your single actual experience of one outcome.
entries.analogy: A die mid-roll (all faces 'live') vs the face you actually read. Physics describes the roll; you only ever live ONE face.
entries.note: STRESSES UN-CLOSABLE. Here the inside (definite experience) and outside (unitary superposition) views have NO agreed bridge. The cut is movable = the seam won't localize. This is the physics cousin of Goedel: the system (universe) described from inside (you, an observer IN it) can't be fully closed from the outside view. [OPEN — and arguably un-closable in principle.]

entries.name: Map / Territory  (representation / reality)  [INSIDE/OUT]
entries.multiplicity: endlessly many maps of one territory (scales, projections, themes) — Borges' 1:1 map IS the territory and so useless
entries.pic_A: MAP: the model/representation (finite, usable, always a simplification)
entries.pic_B: TERRITORY: the thing itself (infinite detail, never fully captured)
entries.primary: Korzybski: 'the map is not the territory.' The map is NEVER primary over what it models; treating the model as the reality is the core error.
entries.equiv: NEVER an equivalence — by construction a usable map OMITS detail. A 1:1 map is the territory itself (Borges) and therefore useless as a map. The gap is PERMANENT: any usable representation is strictly smaller than what it represents.
entries.seam_invariant: whatever the map gets RIGHT — the relations it faithfully preserves (its accuracy domain)
entries.seam_tradeoff: usable AND complete is impossible: to be usable a map must omit; to be complete it must equal the territory and lose all usefulness
entries.gloss: The model vs the real thing. The model is always smaller, on purpose — that's what makes it useful and what makes it incomplete.
entries.analogy: A subway map (clear, usable, geographically wrong) vs the actual tangled city. The lie is what makes it readable.
entries.note: STRESSES UN-CLOSABLE + names the GENERAL form. This is the everyday-language version of Goedel/observer: any inside representation of a whole it is part of is necessarily incomplete. Connects directly to Kelly's frame: the unnameable = the territory no map ever fully closes. PROVABLE that the gap is permanent (a complete map = the territory), un-provable what the omitted remainder fully IS.
